Mint-green cabinets, a chrome-edged laminate table with two vinyl chairs, a white enamel stove, a wall clock, and a window over the sink with café curtains filtering cold winter noon light. Hands in a thin grey knit sweater appear and settle firmly on the near side of the box. With slow steps the viewer pushes it forward about one metre over the clear floor and stops. No body visible except hands and forearms. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, single continuous take without cuts.

object_text: a brown box with a plain lid, deeply creased on one side from a previous stack
wan: Through the person's eyes, about 1.3 metres above the floor and angled down around 30 degrees, a brown box creased on one side waits one metre ahead in a spare room of a 2000s semi-detached house in Seoul's outskirts. Warm-toned yellow ondol vinyl flooring with a faint wood print, white walls with a floral wallpaper border, a folded drying rack, a treadmill against the wall, a wardrobe with sliding doors, and a large window with a mesh screen, light coming in soft and golden at sunset. The viewer's hands, sleeves of a pastel fleece jacket, reach into frame and press on its near side; they walk it slowly forward about one and a half metres across the open floor and stop. Body never visible apart from hands and forearms. No other people. Photorealistic, continuous single take.

object_text: a big boxy brown moving carton with a wobbly hand-cut lid
wan: Through the person's own eyes at about 1.3 metres, looking down about 30 degrees, a big brown moving carton with a hand-cut lid sits a metre ahead on wide painted floorboards in soft grey in a Swedish farmhouse living room. White painted plank walls, a tiled corner stove in pale blue, a long wooden bench along a wall, a rag rug rolled up beside it, checked curtains on small-paned windows, and low pale winter sun at mid-afternoon streaming in sideways. The viewer's hands in fingerless wool gloves enter frame and settle on the near side of the carton; with slow steady steps they push it about two metres across the open floor, then stop. Only hands and forearms appear. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, continuous single shot.

object_text: a medium brown box, its tape half peeled and one flap sticking out sideways
wan: Through the viewer's eyes, around 1.3 metres up and pitched down by about 30 degrees, a medium brown box with half-peeled tape sits one metre ahead in a student flat in Berlin. Scuffed grey linoleum floor, white walls dotted with photos and postcards, a mattress on a low pallet frame, a cheap desk with a laptop, a clothes drying rack, a bicycle helmet on a hook, and a tall old window with flaking paint showing a dull grey afternoon, plus a clip-on desk light. The viewer's hands, wrists ringed with fabric bracelets and sleeves of a black hoodie, reach in and press both palms on the near side of the box, then walk it slowly forward about one and a half metres across the clear floor and stop. Only hands and forearms visible. No other people. Photorealistic, one continuous shot.

object_text: a long low under-bed storage carton in brown cardboard with a printed grid pattern
wan: A camera fixed in a corner at chest height looks into a cramped guest room in a Mumbai high-rise. Glossy beige vitrified tiles cover the floor, walls are pale pistachio, a single steel-frame bed with a block-printed bedspread sits against one wall, a ceiling fan turns slowly, a steel almirah stands in the corner, and a window with a metal grille shows a hazy noon sky. A young woman in her twenties in a cotton kurta and leggings, hair in a braid, bends over and places both hands on the near side of a long, low brown storage carton with a printed grid. She pushes it forward along the open tiled floor with slow steps, sliding it about two metres, then stops and stands. No other people. Photorealistic, continuous shot, no camera cuts, natural movement.

object_text: a weathered reused produce box, soft at the corners, closed with crossed strips of masking tape
wan: A farmhouse kitchen in rural Portugal, filmed by a static camera at chest height from the doorway corner. Worn terracotta floor tiles in uneven reds, whitewashed lime walls, a heavy scrubbed pine table pushed against one side, a blue-and-white tiled backsplash behind a stone sink, hanging copper pans, and a deep window with green wooden shutters open to bright morning sun. A wiry woman in her forties with dark curly hair tied back, wearing a floral apron over a cotton dress and espadrilles, places both hands on the near side of a weathered produce box sealed with crossed masking tape. She pushes it steadily forward across the clear tiled floor, sliding it about two metres with small careful steps, then stops. No other people present. One continuous photorealistic shot with natural motion.

object_text: a medium kraft box sealed with blue painter's tape, a few water spots on one side
wan: A glass-walled sunroom on the back of a 1950s bungalow in coastal South Africa, viewed from a static chest-height camera in the corner. Sand-coloured slate tiles cover the floor; the low brick walls are painted white and topped with wide windows on three sides. A pair of cane chairs with faded floral cushions, a potted bird-of-paradise, a wooden side table with a tea tray, and a ceiling fan complete the room, all bathed in bright, slightly hazy morning light. A grey-haired man in his sixties in a khaki short-sleeved shirt, shorts and sandals bends and places both palms on the near side of a medium kraft box sealed with blue painter's tape. He slides it forward about one metre over the open slate with slow steps, then stops. No other people. Single continuous shot, natural motion, photorealistic.

object_text: a dusty old moving box with yellowed tape and soft, rounded corners
wan: A log cabin living room in the Norwegian mountains, seen from a fixed camera at chest height tucked into a corner. Wide, worn pine floorboards stained dark amber, round log walls, a cast-iron wood stove with a small fire, a sheepskin-covered armchair, a woven wool rug rolled up against the wall, bare log beams, and a small four-pane window showing snow under the pale blue light of a winter dawn. A bearded man in his forties in a patterned wool sweater, thick socks and canvas trousers bends and places both hands on the near side of a dusty old moving box with yellowed tape. He pushes it slowly forward across the open boards, sliding it about two metres, then stops. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, single continuous shot.

object_text: a small sturdy box printed with a light blue pattern, the kind used for kitchenware, corners dented
wan: A narrow galley kitchen in a 1980s retiree's flat in Hong Kong, seen from a fixed camera at chest height near the doorway. Small square white ceramic floor tiles with dark grout, pale green tiled walls, a two-burner stove under a range hood, a steel sink with a dish rack, a rice cooker on the counter, a narrow fridge covered in magnets, and a window with frosted louvres admitting diffuse noon daylight under a fluorescent ceiling tube. A petite woman in her seventies in a quilted vest, loose trousers and cloth slippers stoops carefully and places both hands on the near side of a small dented box printed with light blue pattern, pushing it slowly forward along the clear floor about one metre before stopping. No other people. Photorealistic, one continuous shot, natural motion.

object_text: a brown box half-wrapped in an old patterned bedsheet tied with twine
wan: A static camera at chest height captures the living room of a modest concrete house in a Nairobi suburb from one corner. Polished red cement floor with a soft sheen, walls painted pale turquoise, a wooden sofa set with hand-crocheted cushion covers, a low coffee table, a cabinet holding a small television, a framed family photograph, and a doorway hung with a printed fabric curtain. Late afternoon sun slants through a window with burglar bars, laying stripes across the floor. A middle-aged man in a button-up shirt and pressed trousers bends and places both hands on the near side of a brown box half wrapped in an old patterned bedsheet tied with twine. He slides it forward slowly about one metre over the clear floor and stops. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, one continuous take.

object_text: a medium brown corrugated moving box sealed with clear packing tape
wan: A static camera stands in the corner of a freshly rented one-bedroom flat in a 1990s brick block, at chest height, looking across a living room with pale laminate flooring in a light ash tone. Walls are bare magnolia; a grey fabric sofa sits against the far wall, a rolled rug leans by the window, and a paper-shaded floor lamp stands unplugged. Overcast late-morning light comes through a wide aluminium window. A slim woman in her late twenties, wearing a mustard hoodie and black leggings, bends and places both hands on the near side of a medium brown corrugated moving box. She pushes it steadily forward about one metre across the open floor with slow steps, the box sliding on the laminate, then stops and straightens. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, one continuous shot, no cuts.

object_text: a cream-coloured box with green bands printed around it, a plain storage carton with fold-in handles
wan: A static camera, chest height, in the corner of a laundry room in a suburban house in Texas. The floor is large beige ceramic tile with grey grout, walls are pale yellow semi-gloss, and there is a front-loading washer and dryer pair, a wall-mounted folding shelf with detergent bottles, an ironing board folded against the wall, a utility sink, and a single window with blinds lit by harsh afternoon sun, helped by a fluorescent ceiling tube. A stocky woman in her fifties in a sleeveless top, capri pants and slippers bends and puts both hands on the near side of a cream storage carton with green bands. She pushes it steadily forward about one and a half metres across the open tile with slow steps and stops. No other people. Photorealistic, one continuous shot.

object_text: a compact brown box with a carry slot on each side, stacked-on lid removed and taped flat
wan: A static chest-height camera in the corner of a dining area in a 2000s apartment in Istanbul. The floor is cool grey marble-look porcelain tile, walls are warm beige with a decorative ceiling cornice, and there is a round glass dining table with four upholstered chairs, a dark wood sideboard holding tea glasses, a crystal-drop pendant lamp lit warmly, and a balcony door with lace curtains admitting the blue light of late evening. A woman in her late forties wearing a long cardigan, a headscarf in muted rose and trousers places both hands on the near side of a compact brown box with carry slots and pushes it slowly forward about one metre over the clear floor, then stops and straightens. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, one continuous shot with no cuts.

object_text: a pale tan e-commerce box, light and new, with a shipping label peeled off leaving white residue
wan: A static wide view at chest height from the corner of a bright living room in a modern Lagos duplex. Large glossy white porcelain tiles reflect the light; walls are cream with a feature wall of carved wooden panels. There is a deep brown leather sofa set, a glass coffee table, a tall standing fan, potted palms, and wide windows with net curtains admitting hot white noon sun. A middle-aged woman in a bright patterned wrap dress and head wrap bends forward and sets both hands on the near side of a pale tan e-commerce box with label residue on top. She walks it forward slowly across the clear tile floor, sliding it about two metres, then stops and straightens up. No other people in frame. Photorealistic, natural motion, a single continuous shot with no cuts.

object_text: a recycled grey-brown box with corners frayed, tied with jute string
wan: A traditional washitsu room in an older wooden house in Kyoto, filmed from a fixed chest-height camera in one corner. Tatami-style woven mats cover the floor in a soft straw green; sliding paper screens and a plain clay-plaster wall surround the space. A low lacquered table, two flat floor cushions, a tokonoma alcove with a single ceramic vase, and a glass sliding door to a small garden filled with early morning light complete the room. A lean elderly man in his seventies in a dark indigo samue jacket and trousers kneels, then rises to a crouch and places both hands on the near side of a recycled grey-brown box tied with jute string. He slides it slowly forward across the open mats about one metre and stops. No other people. Photorealistic, continuous single shot.

object_text: an oversized cardboard box from a household appliance, plain brown with cut-out handholds
wan: A utility room built into a converted garage of a family house in suburban Arizona, filmed from a static chest-height camera in the corner. The floor is sealed epoxy-coated concrete in speckled tan; walls are painted drywall in off-white. Metal storage shelving with plain plastic tubs, a chest freezer, a workbench with hand tools, a water heater, and a roll-up door with small panel windows letting in bright desert afternoon light, plus overhead LED shop lights. A fit woman in her thirties with a ponytail, wearing a tank top, cargo shorts and running shoes, places both hands on the near side of an oversized plain brown appliance box with cut-out handholds and pushes it steadily forward about two metres across the open floor with slow steps, then stops. No other people. Photorealistic, continuous shot, no cuts.

object_text: a slightly crushed brown box with its top flaps folded and taped in a criss-cross pattern
wan: An attic bedroom under a steep pitched roof in a German row house, recorded by a fixed camera at chest height from the low corner. Painted white floorboards, sloping ceilings with exposed spruce beams, a skylight casting a bright square of morning sun, a single bed with a checked blanket, a small wooden wardrobe, a reading lamp clipped to a beam, and a framed map leaning on the knee wall. A lanky student in his early twenties with glasses, a grey hoodie and cargo shorts ducks slightly under the slope, places both hands on the near side of a slightly crushed brown box with criss-cross taped flaps, and pushes it forward about one metre across the clear floor with slow steps, then stops. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, single continuous take.

object_text: a heavy-duty brown box with a printed fragile symbol of a wine glass and wide yellow tape
wan: Dining room of a 1930s semi-detached house in Dublin, seen from a static camera at chest height in the corner by the bay window. The floor is dark stained pine boards with a worn finish, the walls deep plum with a picture rail, and the room holds an extendable mahogany table pushed to one side with chairs stacked on it, a glass-fronted china cabinet, a brass chandelier, and a tiled fireplace. Rainy grey afternoon light mixes with the warm chandelier. A red-haired woman in her thirties in a chunky cream jumper, jeans and trainers leans in, places both hands on the near side of a sturdy brown box printed with a fragile symbol, and pushes it slowly forward across the open boards about two metres, then stops. No other people. Photorealistic, one continuous shot, natural motion.

object_text: a tall rectangular book box with handle cutouts and faded black marker scribbles
wan: In a 1970s suburban ranch house in the American Midwest, a fixed camera sits at chest height in the corner of a wood-panelled study. The floor is rust-coloured low-pile carpet; knotty pine panelling covers the walls. There is a heavy oak desk with a green-shaded lamp, a built-in bookcase half emptied, a plaid recliner, and a sliding glass door to a patio with afternoon sun streaming in at a low angle. A retired woman in her late sixties with short silver hair, wearing a lavender cardigan and slacks, leans in and presses both hands against the near side of a tall book box with handle cutouts and faded marker scribbles. She shuffles forward and slides it about one metre across the carpet, then stops to rest. No other people. Single continuous shot, natural motion, photorealistic.

object_text: a mid-size brown box with a pull-tab tear strip and taped-on bubble wrap on top
wan: In the communal living room of a shared student house in Leeds, the camera stays fixed at chest height in a corner. Faded burgundy low-pile carpet with a few stains covers the floor; magnolia woodchip walls hold a couple of plain posters. There is a mismatched pair of sofas, a coffee table with mugs, a cheap bookcase, and a sash window with a broken blind showing an overcast early evening, helped by a single paper-globe ceiling light. A short young woman of twenty in a plain black T-shirt, plaid pyjama trousers and socks bends and puts both hands on the near side of a mid-size brown box with bubble wrap taped on top. She pushes it forward with slow steps about one and a half metres across the clear carpet, then stops. No other people. Photorealistic, single continuous take.

object_text: a big brown TV-sized moving box, nearly cubic, with strapping tape across the middle
wan: In the finished basement of a Canadian split-level family house, the camera is planted at chest height in one corner and never moves. The floor is grey-beige low-pile carpet tile, walls are painted a soft blue above white wainscot, and the room holds a sectional couch, a foosball table, a mini fridge, a shelf of board games, and two small high windows letting in dim overcast light, helped by warm pot lights in the drop ceiling. A sturdy teenage-looking young adult man of about nineteen in a hockey jersey and track pants places both hands on the near side of a big nearly cubic moving box with strapping tape and leans in, pushing it steadily about one and a half metres across the open carpet before stopping. No other people. Photorealistic, continuous shot, natural motion.

object_text: a tall brown moving box for linens, about knee-plus height, with a printed size grid on the side
wan: Inside a converted barn in rural Vermont, a static camera at chest height looks from the corner across a loft-style bedroom. Wide reclaimed pine floorboards with knots and nail marks, rough-sawn timber posts, whitewashed board walls, a black iron bed with a quilt, an antique dresser, a woven rag rug pushed against the bed, and a large arched window filled with soft golden autumn evening light, joined by a warm bedside lamp. A tall woman in her forties with a long grey-streaked braid, wearing a denim shirt and wool socks, puts both hands on the near side of a tall linen moving box and leans her weight in, pushing it slowly forward about one and a half metres across the open boards before stopping. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, the camera never cuts.

object_text: a bright white mailer-style box with clean sharp edges
wan: Minimalist Scandinavian bedroom in a 2010s apartment in Copenhagen, seen from a fixed chest-height camera in the far corner. Wide whitewashed oak floorboards, soft white walls, a low bed with linen sheets in oatmeal, a rattan pendant lamp, a pale birch dresser, a sheepskin draped over a wooden chair, and a tall window with sheer curtains glowing in overcast midday light. A slender non-binary person in their thirties with a cropped blonde haircut, wearing a loose oatmeal knit sweater and wide trousers, kneels briefly, then rises into a crouch and puts both hands on the near side of a crisp white mailer box. They push it slowly forward across the open boards about one metre, the box sliding smoothly, then stop. No other people. Photorealistic, single continuous shot, camera does not cut.

object_text: a medium box covered in coloured stickers and doodles, used as a kids' toy box, lid taped shut
wan: One continuous photorealistic shot from a static chest-height camera in the corner of a cheerful playroom in a Buenos Aires family house. Honey-toned pine floorboards, walls painted coral below a white rail and cream above, a low shelf crammed with picture books, a wooden play kitchen, a beanbag in mustard yellow, string lights, and a tall window with wooden shutters half open to golden late-afternoon light. A father in his thirties with a short beard, wearing a striped polo and chinos, crouches and puts both hands on the near side of a medium box covered in stickers and doodles, its lid taped shut. He pushes it steadily forward about one and a half metres across the open floor with slow steps and stops. No other people appear. Natural motion, the camera does not cut.

object_text: a small cube-shaped kraft box with a strip of red tape across the top
wan: Photorealistic video, one unbroken take. The camera is static on a tripod at chest height in the corner of a compact high-rise studio in Seoul, showing a polished light-grey vinyl plank floor, white walls, a low platform bed with a beige duvet, a folding wall desk, a small refrigerator under a counter, and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking apartment towers at dusk. Warm LED strip light under the cabinets mixes with the blue evening sky. A young man in his early twenties in a black oversized T-shirt and grey sweatpants crouches slightly and sets both hands on the near side of a small cube-shaped kraft box with a strip of red tape. He pushes it forward along the open floor with slow, steady steps, sliding it about two metres toward the window, then stops. No other people in the room.

object_text: a pristine white-and-brown two-tone moving box with a reinforced bottom
wan: Photorealistic, single uncut shot. A camera is fixed at chest height in the corner of a child's bedroom in a newly built suburban house in Singapore. Light grey wood-look vinyl flooring, walls painted pale mint with a hand-painted cloud mural, a white bunk bed, a small desk with a gooseneck lamp, a toy shelf with soft animals, and a large window with sheer white curtains under bright, humid midday light and a quiet ceiling fan. A slim father in his forties wearing a polo shirt and shorts leans in, sets both hands on the near side of a two-tone white-and-brown moving box with a reinforced bottom, and pushes it steadily forward about one and a half metres across the clear floor with slow steps before stopping. No other people in the room. Natural motion.

object_text: a long rectangular flat-pack furniture carton lying on its wide side, brown with black print lines
wan: Photorealistic, unbroken shot from a camera held fixed at chest height in the corner of a small rental flat in a Warsaw prefab block. The floor is honey-coloured oak-look laminate with a slight sheen, walls are plain white with a few nail holes, and there is a dated brown wall unit, a pull-out sofa bed in blue, a folding table with two chairs, a radiator under a wide double-glazed window, and cold blue winter twilight outside mixed with a single bare ceiling bulb. A young man in his late twenties in a black puffer vest, thermal shirt and jeans stoops and sets both hands on the near end of a long flat-pack furniture carton lying on its side, then pushes it steadily forward about two metres across the clear floor and stops. No other people.

object_text: a tall brown kitchen-goods box marked only with a hand-drawn arrow, taped along every seam
wan: Shot from a static camera at chest height in the corner of the entryway of a 1960s concrete apartment in Mexico City. The floor is speckled granite-chip terrazzo in cream and grey; walls are painted a warm ochre. A carved wooden bench, a mirror with a tin frame, a potted monstera, a shoe rack, and a heavy door with a frosted glass side panel fill the space. Late afternoon sunlight cuts across the floor from a high window. A broad-shouldered man in his forties, wearing a white guayabera shirt and jeans, places both hands on the near face of a tall brown box with a hand-drawn arrow and pushes it forward with slow, steady steps, sliding it about one and a half metres over the smooth terrazzo, then stops. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, one continuous take.

object_text: a large double-wall shipping box with brown tape and a torn corner flap
wan: Single continuous shot from a fixed camera mounted at chest height at the end of a long narrow hallway in a Victorian terraced house in northern England. Original encaustic tiles in terracotta, cream and black run the length of the floor; the lower walls have dark green painted panelling and the upper walls are off-white. A coat stand, a slim radiator, a botanical print and a stained-glass panel above the front door frame the scene. Cool daylight filters through the coloured glass. A heavyset man in his fifties with a grey beard, flannel shirt and work trousers puts both palms on the near face of the box and pushes it forward along the clear tiled floor, sliding it about one and a half metres with deliberate steps before stopping. No other people. Photorealistic, natural movement, camera never cuts.

object_text: a shiny brown box wrapped in a layer of stretch film, a grey strap around the middle
wan: Single continuous take from a fixed camera at chest height in the corner of an industrial loft in a converted warehouse in Brooklyn. The floor is polished grey concrete with faint trowel marks; walls are exposed red brick with black steel-frame windows taking up one side, letting in hard noon sun in long rectangles. There is a leather chesterfield sofa, a long reclaimed-wood dining table at the far end, a steel bookcase, a large rubber plant, and pendant Edison bulbs. A muscular man in his thirties with tattooed forearms, a white T-shirt and black jeans places both hands on the near side of a shrink-wrapped brown box with a grey strap and pushes it forward steadily, sliding it about two metres over the open concrete with slow steps, then stops. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion.

object_text: a scuffed archive-style box with a separate lid, olive-grey cardboard
wan: Static chest-height camera in the corner of a home office in a converted 19th-century Parisian apartment. Herringbone oak parquet glows honey-coloured; walls are pale grey with tall plaster mouldings. A marble fireplace, a narrow writing desk with a brass lamp, a velvet armchair in teal, overflowing bookshelves, and tall French windows with thin curtains let in soft grey winter light. A man in his sixties with round glasses, a tweed jacket and corduroy trousers stoops and puts both hands on the near side of a scuffed olive-grey archive box with a separate lid. He pushes it slowly forward over the clear parquet, sliding about one metre, and stops. No other people. Photorealistic, natural motion, one continuous shot without cuts.

object_text: a wide flat-topped corrugated box wrapped twice around with brown parcel tape, slightly dented on one edge
wan: The camera does not move: it is locked off at chest height in a corner of an open-plan living and kitchen space in a new-build townhouse outside Melbourne. Pale polished concrete floors, white walls with a single sage feature wall, a stone-topped island with three timber stools, a low-slung charcoal sofa, a fiddle-leaf fig in a woven basket, and large sliding doors onto a deck flooded with clear noon sun. A tall, athletic man in his thirties, in a navy singlet, board shorts and bare feet, places both hands flat on the near side of a wide corrugated box with a dented edge. He walks it forward with slow steps, the box gliding about one and a half metres over the concrete toward the deck doors, and stops. No other people. Photorealistic, continuous single shot, natural motion.

object_text: a weathered gray-painted farmhouse desk with distressed edges and a lower stretcher bar
wan: A first-person POV at about 1.3 metres, tilted down 30 degrees, one continuous take. Roughly one metre ahead on the floor is a weathered grey-painted farmhouse desk with distressed edges and a low stretcher bar between its legs, empty. It sits in the mudroom of a Vermont farmhouse: dark slate floor tiles with muddy boot prints, white beadboard walls, a row of iron hooks with barn coats, a boot tray, a wooden bench under a window and a back door with a glass panel showing flat overcast afternoon light. Only my hands and forearms in a quilted canvas jacket appear, grip the desk's near edge and push it forward about two metres, sliding it across the slate in slow steps, then stop. No other people anywhere. Photorealistic.

object_text: a cheap black particleboard desk with a peeling edge strip and thin tube legs
wan: Egocentric POV, eye height about 1.3 m, camera tilted down about 30 degrees toward the floor, single continuous take. A cheap black particleboard desk with a peeling edge strip and thin tube legs sits about one metre in front of me on stained beige carpet. Around it is a small rental flat bedroom in an older London conversion: woodchip wallpaper painted off-white, a single radiator under a draughty sash window with condensation, a clothes airer with drying shirts, a futon folded up and a wall-mounted shelf with a kettle. Weak grey morning light mixes with a ceiling pendant bulb. Only my hands and forearms in a navy fleece enter the frame, press flat against the desk's near edge and push it forward about two metres across the carpet in slow steps until I stop. No other people. Photorealistic.

object_text: a light grey compact desk with a rounded bullnose top and slim conical wooden legs
wan: Egocentric point of view from roughly 1.3 m, gaze dipped 30 degrees, one continuous realistic take. About one metre ahead on the floor stands a light grey compact desk with a rounded bullnose top and slim conical wooden legs, empty. It is in a high-rise apartment living room in Shanghai: glossy dark wood-look laminate, white walls, a grey fabric sofa with embroidered cushions, a glass cabinet with tea sets, a large potted money tree and a wide window with a hazy skyline at dusk; warm ceiling downlights are on. My hands and forearms in a soft beige jumper enter the frame, rest on the near edge and push the desk forward about one and a half metres over clear floor with slow steps, then stop. No other people. Photorealistic.

object_text: a cream lacquered writing desk with brass-capped feet and a plain smooth top
wan: Egocentric view from 1.3 metres, gaze angled down about 30 degrees, one continuous take. A cream lacquered writing desk with brass-capped feet stands empty one metre in front of me. The bedroom is in a Haussmann-era Paris apartment: chevron oak parquet with a honey sheen, pale grey walls with ornate plaster panels, a marble fireplace, a velvet armchair, a tall gilt mirror and floor-to-ceiling French windows with sheer curtains glowing with soft overcast midday light. My hands and slender forearms in a silk blouse sleeve reach into frame, rest on the desk's near edge and push it forward about one metre across clear parquet with slow steps, then stop. No other people. Photorealistic and natural.

object_text: a dark-stained mango-wood desk with iron hairpin legs and visible grain
wan: Egocentric view from 1.3 metres, looking down at about 30 degrees, one continuous take without cuts. One metre in front of me on the floor is a dark-stained mango-wood desk on black iron hairpin legs, its bold grain bare. The study opens onto the courtyard of a house in Marrakech: geometric zellige floor tiles in green and white, smooth tadelakt walls in warm sand, a carved cedar door standing open, a brass lantern hanging overhead, a leather pouf and a low cushioned bench. Midday light falls from the courtyard and makes sharp shadow patterns. My hands, with forearms bare under rolled cotton sleeves, come into view, settle on the near edge and push the desk steadily forward about two metres across the tiles in slow steps, then stop. No other people. Photorealistic.

object_text: a slim white desk with a mint-green tabletop and rounded legs
wan: Egocentric view from about 1.3 metres, angled down 30 degrees, a continuous shot with no cuts. A slim white desk with a mint-green top and rounded legs stands empty one metre ahead on the floor. It is in a small flat in Buenos Aires: worn pinewood parquet in a basketweave pattern, high ceilings, walls in faded peach, a tall French balcony door with peeling paint showing bright midday sun and plants on the balcony, a vintage armchair, a record shelf and a ceiling fan. My hands and forearms with a beaded bracelet appear, rest on the near edge and push the desk forward about one metre with slow steps across the open parquet, then stop. No other people anywhere. Photorealistic and natural.

object_text: a chalky white-painted pine desk with a sky-blue drawer front and wooden knob
wan: Egocentric view, head about 1.3 metres up, angled down 30 degrees, a continuous shot with no cuts.
